recipe.visualDefinition: A three-person portrait featuring a central male figure flanked by two women, set against a gold-and-white vertical striped backdrop. The image utilizes a high-contrast, slightly grainy photographic style typical of late 1970s fashion photography, with a prominent boxed typographic lockup in the top left corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure as the vertical axis for the composition
Interaction between the subjects creating a tight, triangular cluster
Contrast between dark clothing and the bright, reflective striped background
Typographic box acting as a heavy visual weight in the upper left quadrant
coreInvariants: Vertical gold and white pinstripe background
Square framing for the overall composition
Black rectangular box containing all primary text elements
High-key lighting with soft, blooming highlights

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subjects are centered horizontally, occupying the middle and lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The black text box in the top left corner serves as the primary anchor against the busy background.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top-left text box, move down the left subject's arm, across the central figure, and up to the right subject's face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, primarily located in the upper right and around the typographic box.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Gold and white vertical stripes provide the primary tonal texture.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black in the clothing and the text box provides structural contrast.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted reds and blues in the scarves, eyewear, and illustrated masks.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value with moderate saturation; colors feel aged and warm.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely high aspect ratio (tall and narrow)
High stroke contrast between thick verticals and thin horizontals
characterSpecificRedesigns: Uniform cap height across all letters
Vertical stress in all rounded characters

composition.relationshipToImage: separated from display text by graphic icons

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for the name paired with a clean, spaced-out sans-serif for the title.
graphicDevices: Small illustrated icons (masks) centered between text lines

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the extreme verticality and sharp serifs of the display text.
Suitable for the secondary subtitle text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A soft-focus 1970s style photograph of three people (one man in a scarf and cap, two women in black dresses) posing closely together. The background is a wall with vertical gold and white stripes. The lighting is warm and slightly overexposed.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Create a black rectangle in the top left corner with a thin gold double-border. Place the primary name in an extra-condensed bold serif font at the top. Place three small illustrated masquerade masks in the center. Place the title in a spaced-out gold sans-serif at the bottom.

verificationChecks: Is the display font extremely tall and narrow?
Is the background composed of vertical stripes?
Is the text contained within a bordered black box?
Is the overall color palette warm and gold-toned?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
Specific brand logos in the corners
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text box does not obscure the subjects' faces.
Ensure the stripes are perfectly vertical.
Verify the serif font has high stroke contrast.
Confirm the overall image has a square aspect ratio.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-fashion trio portrait with a pinstripe background and a framed typographic lockup using extra-condensed serifs.
